prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1425; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the crash and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide a complete statement of the liability limits under each policy that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle, including any excess or umbrella coverage. Please also confirm in writing whether a claim has been opened and identify the assigned adjuster.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, dashcam or telematics data, recorded statements, police and incident reports, vehicle repair and salvage records, and any electronic data stored in the vehicles involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such materials while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
